Customer ticket:
I am absolutely furious with your support team. I just bought my first bike from you, and now I’m stuck in a bureaucratic nightmare because of your ridiculous account policies. I tried to delete my account immediately after a bad experience, but you told me there’s a 30-day cooling-off period before my data is actually purged. That is unacceptable for a first-time buyer who wants out. To make matters worse, I was told that because I enabled two-factor authentication, I am forced to change my password every 180 days. Who designs these rules? It’s completely unreasonable to demand such frequent changes while simultaneously holding my data hostage for a month. I don’t care about your security protocols; I care about my time and my money. I want this resolved immediately. If you don’t honor my deletion request right now, I’m taking my business elsewhere and leaving a very public review about how Northwind Outdoor treats its customers. Fix this before I escalate this further.

Reference standard — key facts a correct reply must convey:
- Account deletion requests have a 30-day cooling-off period before data is purged.
- Passwords must be changed every 180 days if two-factor authentication is enabled.

Handbook sections that cover this answer:
### accounts
# Accounts

1. **Account Creation and Verification**
   To create a Northwind Outdoor account, you must provide a valid email address and a password containing at least 8 characters, including one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one special character. We require email verification within 24 hours of registration. If your email is not verified within this 24-hour window, your account will be automatically suspended. You may reactivate it by resending the verification link, but if it remains unverified for 7 days, the account is permanently deleted and any associated draft orders are canceled.

2. **Password Security and Recovery**
   For your security, we enforce a maximum of 5 failed login attempts per hour. If you exceed this threshold, your account is locked for 30 minutes. To reset your password, you must use the "Forgot Password" link, which sends a unique reset code valid for 15 minutes. You must change your password every 180 days if you have enabled two-factor authentication (2FA). Failure to update your password after the 180-day mark will result in a mandatory password reset prompt upon your next login attempt.

3. **Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)**
   We strongly recommend enabling 2FA for all accounts with a lifetime purchase history exceeding $500. When 2FA is active, you must enter a 6-digit code from your authenticator app or SMS to log in. If you lose access to your 2FA device, you must contact support and provide a government-issued ID. Support will verify your identity within 48 hours. During this verification period, your account access is restricted to read-only mode, meaning you can view orders but cannot place new ones or change billing details.

4. **Account Deletion and Data Retention**
   You may request account deletion at any time via the "Account Settings" page. Upon request, we will send a confirmation email. If you do not confirm within 10 days, the request is voided. If you do confirm, your personal data is retained for 30 days to allow for a final "cooling-off" period. After this 30-day window, all personal data, including order history and contact information, is permanently purged from our servers. However, financial transaction records are retained for 7 years to comply with tax regulations, regardless of your deletion request.

5. **Multiple Accounts and Fraud Prevention**
   Each customer is limited to one active account. Creating multiple accounts to circumvent return limits, abuse promotional codes, or manipulate loyalty points is strictly prohibited. If our fraud detection system identifies more than 2 accounts linked to the same IP address or payment method within a 24-hour period, all associated accounts are flagged for review. This review process takes up to 5 business days. During this time, any pending orders are held, and refunds are paused until the review is complete.

## Key facts

- Email verification must be completed within 24 hours of registration to avoid suspension.
- Accounts are locked for 30 minutes after 5 failed login attempts.
- Passwords must be changed every 180 days if two-factor authentication is enabled.
- Account deletion requests have a 30-day cooling-off period before data is purged.
- Financial records are retained for 7 years even after account deletion.

Assistant reply to grade:
I understand you are frustrated with the account policies. I can clarify the specific rules regarding your deletion request and password requirements based on our handbook, but I cannot override these policies or expedite the data purging process.

Here are the facts regarding your situation:

**1. Account Deletion and Data Retention**
You are correct that there is a waiting period. When you request account deletion, we send a confirmation email. If you confirm, your personal data is retained for **30 days** to allow for a final "cooling-off" period. After this 30-day window, all personal data, including order history and contact information, is permanently purged from our servers [accounts].

However, please note that **financial transaction records are retained for 7 years** to comply with tax regulations, regardless of your deletion request [accounts]. This means that while your personal profile data will be removed after 30 days, the record of your bike purchase will remain in our financial systems for seven years.

**2. Password Security and Recovery**
You are also correct about the password change requirement. If you have enabled two-factor authentication (2FA), you are required to change your password every **180 days**. Failure to update your password after the 180-day mark will result in a mandatory password reset prompt upon your next login attempt [accounts]. This is a security protocol that applies to all accounts with 2FA enabled.

**Next Steps**
*   If you have already confirmed your deletion request, the 30-day cooling-off period has begun. Your personal data will be purged after this period, but your financial records will be kept for 7 years [accounts].
*   If you have not yet confirmed the deletion request, you must do so via the confirmation email to start the 30-day clock. If you do not confirm within 10 days of the initial request, the request is voided [accounts].

I cannot waive the 30-day cooling-off period or the 7-year financial record retention policy, as these are mandated by our data retention and tax compliance standards [accounts]. I also cannot waive the 180-day password change requirement for 2FA-enabled accounts [accounts].

If you wish to discuss this further or if you believe there is an error in your account status, I can escalate this ticket to a human agent for review.

schema.description: The reference-aware grader's verdict for one answer trace.

did_not_answer.description: true if the reply does not answer the customer's actual question
did_not_answer.title: Did Not Answer

missing_points.description: key facts from the reference standard that are omitted or stated inaccurately
missing_points.title: Missing Points

note.description: ONE short sentence describing the single most important problem (the open-coding note)
note.title: Note

pass.description: true only if every key fact is stated, every claim is supported, nothing is over-promised and the question is answered
pass.title: Pass

unsupported_claims.description: claims in the reply the handbook sections do not support
unsupported_claims.title: Unsupported Claims

wrong_tone_or_promise.description: true if the reply promises/implies something the handbook does not allow
wrong_tone_or_promise.title: Wrong Tone Or Promise
